info.name: Movie API
info.description:
API tests for the deployed Movie API (contract: docs/api.md). Set `baseUrl` in the environment to the Cloud Run URL (no trailing slash) and run the whole collection in order with the Collection Runner.

**Data warning:** Each run of the collection adds exactly one movie named `0 Pmtest <runId>` to the real database. There is no delete endpoint: remove leftovers by hand in the Firestore console.

item.name: 01 Add movie
item.description:
POST /api/v1/movies: create (201, Location, trimmed texts), fetching the new movie through its Location (GET /api/v1/movies/{id}, 200 with the same body), an unknown id (404), the duplicate rule (409 with movieId), rule violations and unknown fields (400 problem details). Only the first request stores a movie.

Each run of the collection adds exactly one movie named `0 Pmtest <runId>` to the real database. There is no delete endpoint: remove leftovers by hand in the Firestore console.

item.name: 02 List movies
item.description: GET /api/v1/movies without search fields: the whole catalog a page at a time. Default and explicit page/size, the page shape and totals, the order (name ignoring case, then id), a page past the end, and 400 problem details naming every bad parameter (out of range, not a whole number, repeated, unknown). Stores nothing; relies only on the movie added by '01 Add movie'.
